item.description:
What's new in ShawNotch 1.7.32

  • The Dock comes back after Clean Desktop even when a full-screen app or video is in front. macOS ignores the request while you're in full screen, so ShawNotch now checks that the Dock has really returned and asks again once you're back on the desktop.
  • If your Dock ever stays hidden, the notch's right-click menu and the menu bar menu now offer Fix a Missing Dock… to bring it back.
  • A Dock you hide on purpose stays hidden after Clean Desktop.
